title: Backup Envelope Schema
description: The full-data-backup file: a complete, restorable snapshot of one device's user state. Produced by app/src/lib/backupFormat.js buildBackup() and consumed by parseBackup() + db.js restoreFromBackup(). This is ALSO the wire format synced by cloud-account-llm-rutina Section D (spec D4) — the future backend validates against a vendored copy of this file. Rutina payloads inside data.rutinas[].rutina are validated SEPARATELY, by id, against data/equipment.json via scripts/lib/rutina-validator.js (not expressible in JSON Schema alone) — same split as rutina.schema.json. additionalProperties is deliberately permissive at the envelope and data levels: spec AC10 requires unknown fields within a known formatVersion to be ignored, never fatal.

formatVersion.description: Backup format version. Starts at 1. A file with a HIGHER value than the app understands is rejected with 'update the app' (AC10); a LOWER known value is migrated forward.

appVersion.description: package.json version of the app that produced the file (AC2). Informational; not used to gate restore.

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of export (AC2). The only field that differs between two consecutive exports of an unchanged state (AC5).

rutinas.description: The rutina library — every entry from the IndexedDB `rutinas` store, verbatim. Order is by `seq`.

rutina.description: The validated rutina payload. Re-validated on restore against data/equipment.json (AC11).

importedAt.description: ISO timestamp the entry was added.

seq.description: Monotonic insertion counter — preserves library order across UUID keys.

activeRutinaId.description: The `id` of the active library entry, or null when none is active (empty-library state, spec AC5 of multi-rutina-library). Restores to activeRutina.current = {key:'current', rutinaId:<this>}.

sessions.description: Every session from the IndexedDB `sessions` store, all statuses, full exercises[] detail (weightUsed, difficulty, completedAt, dayIndex, rutinaId, attribution snapshot). Written verbatim on restore.

lastWeights.description: The per-exercise working-weight store, included for completeness/debuggability (AC1). NOT trusted on restore — db.js restoreFromBackup RECOMPUTES lastWeights from the restored sessions under saveSession's predicate; the sessions win (AC8).

settings.description: localStorage settings, keyed by their real storage key. ONLY the keys on app/src/lib/settingsRegistry.js's allowlist appear here — session tokens and the club-equipment outbox are structurally excluded (spec AC14 / cloud AC7). Values are the raw localStorage strings, restored verbatim. Unknown keys in a file are ignored on restore (AC10).
